title: A document preview request
scope: One synchronous preview request from handler to renderer. Background jobs and retries are outside this trace.

nodes.label: Receive preview request
nodes.summary: The handler requires both a user and a document before continuing.

nodes.label: Check active membership and access
nodes.summary: The authorization function blocks inactive membership and private documents.
assumptions: The document visibility rules are represented by can_view; that function is outside this fixture.

nodes.label: Ask the renderer for a preview
nodes.summary: The handler returns the renderer result when access is allowed.

nodes.label: Return a retryable unavailable result
nodes.summary: Renderer timeout is represented as an unavailable response.

nodes.label: Whether the caller retries
nodes.summary: The caller retry behavior is not present in these files.
assumptions: The example does not claim a retry occurs.

paths.label: Access allowed
paths.trigger: A complete request from an active member who can view the document.

steps.explanation: The handler rejects incomplete arguments before authorization.
Active membership is required and document visibility is checked.
An allowed decision forwards the document content to the renderer.

paths.label: Access denied
paths.trigger: The user is missing, inactive, or cannot view the document.

steps.explanation: The request reaches the handler with a user and document.
A failed membership or visibility check returns a denied decision.

paths.label: Renderer times out
paths.trigger: Authorization succeeds but rendering exceeds its timeout.

steps.explanation: The user is allowed to view the document.
The renderer catches its timeout and returns a retryable unavailable result.

paths.outcome: A retryable unavailable response is returned.

questions.label: What happens when rendering times out?
Does the caller retry after a timeout?
questions.note: Not covered: the caller retry policy is outside the cited source files.
